newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER GO JOINT TOP BY BEATING PARMA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER GO JOINT TOP BY BEATING PARMA.

text.p: Chile's Ivan Zamorano struck twice as Internazionale fought back from a goal down to defeat Parma 3-1 at the San Siro on Sunday and join Juventus in a two-way tie at the top of the table.
Hernan Crespo put the visitors ahead in the first minute but Zamorano, who joined from Real Madrid in the close season, equalised three minutes later with his first serie A goal.
Roy Hodgson's side, under pressure following last week's defeat to Juventus, took the lead through Argentine Javier Zanetti on the brink of halftime.
Zamorano added a third in the 54th minute to leave Juventus regretting Roma's injury-time equaliser in their 1-1 draw at the Olympic stadium on Saturday night.
Inter are now tied with the European champions on 14 points after seven matches, one ahead of unfancied Vicenza, 2-0 winners over Cagliari, playing their first match under manager Carlo Mazzone.
Champions Milan dropped to fourth after going down to an 87th minute goal from Anselmo Robbiati at Fiorentina, their third defeat of the season under new coach Oscar Tabarez.
Both sides finished the match with 10 men after Milan's Stefano Eranio was sent off in the 45th minute and Fiorentina's Aldo Firicano was dismissed in the 88th.
